phaseAHarnessCommitSemantics.role: provenance metadata, not the integrity boundary
phaseAHarnessCommitSemantics.requiredShape: exactly 40 lowercase or uppercase hexadecimal characters
phaseAHarnessCommitSemantics.rationale: A squash merge onto main creates one new commit and intentionally discards the source branch's commit ancestry; a provenance commit's ancestry or continued local presence must not be part of the merge-strategy-independent integrity check.
phaseAHarnessCommitSemantics.integrityBoundary: Exact equality between runManifest.phaseAHarnessArtifacts and the harness artifact snapshot (sorted file paths, every per-file SHA-256, and the aggregate SHA-256) recomputed from current HEAD via Git object reads under harnessArtifactPaths.
phaseAHarnessCommitSemantics.whenProvenanceCommitIsLocallyAvailable: Its harness artifact snapshot is additionally recomputed and must also equal runManifest.phaseAHarnessArtifacts; ancestry to current HEAD is still not required.
phaseAHarnessCommitSemantics.whenProvenanceCommitIsNotLocallyAvailabl: Verification does not fail solely for that reason, as long as the current-HEAD artifact snapshot equals runManifest.phaseAHarnessArtifacts.
